dishes.name: Handi Paneer
dishes.description: Rich, aromatic curry with soft paneer cubes and traditional Indian spices.
dishes.fullDescription: Fresh malai paneer simmered in an earthenware clay pot with freshly crushed coriander seeds, Kashmiri red chilies, and a velvety onion-tomato masala enriched with churned butter and fenugreek.
dishes.chefNote: Slow-simmered in clay handi to impart authentic rustic smoked earthiness.

dishes.name: Paneer Lababdar
dishes.description: Creamy tomato-based gravy enriched with grated paneer and coriander.
dishes.fullDescription: Succulent cubes of cottage cheese enveloped in a luscious, mildly sweet and tangy gravy of vine-ripened tomatoes, cashew butter, ginger juliennes and aromatic cardamom.
dishes.chefNote: Finished with a drizzle of heavy cream and slow-roasted cumin butter.

dishes.name: Veg Biryani
dishes.description: Fragrant long-grain basmati with garden vegetables, saffron and herbs.
dishes.fullDescription: Aromatic Daawat basmati rice sealed with dough and slow-cooked over low embers (Dum) with baby carrots, French beans, cauliflower florets, Kashmiri saffron milk and fresh garden mint.
dishes.chefNote: Served with chilled pomegranate burani raita and spicy salan.

dishes.name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
dishes.description: Authentic Nizami spice blend layered with basmati and fried onions.
dishes.fullDescription: Steeped in royal Nizami tradition, layers of long-grain rice infused with crushed star anise, cinnamon quills, marinated soya chaap, caramelized birista, and saffron milk.
dishes.chefNote: Steamed in copper degh to lock in the fragrant steam.

dishes.name: Chaap Tikka Biryani
dishes.description: Tandoor-smoked marinated soya chaap layered with fragrant spiced rice.
dishes.fullDescription: Plump soya chaap chunks marinated in mustard oil, hung curd, and roasted gram flour, charred over charcoal and then folded into fragrant saffron basmati rice.
dishes.chefNote: Smoked with charcoal embers and clove essence before serving.

dishes.name: Paneer 65
dishes.description: Crispy fried paneer tossed in fiery curry leaves and mustard seeds.
dishes.fullDescription: Crisp paneer bites dusted with rice flour and Southern spices, quick-fried and tossed in a sizzling tempering of curry leaves, crushed black pepper, green chilies and tangy curd.
dishes.chefNote: Tossed fresh per order so the exterior maintains its signature crackle.

dishes.name: Crispy Honey Chilli Potato
dishes.description: Golden fried potato fingers coated in a spicy sweet garlic sauce.
dishes.fullDescription: Twice-fried crisp potato batons tossed in a flaming wok with garlic, ginger, dark soy, red chili paste, wild forest honey, and toasted white sesame seeds.
dishes.chefNote: Garnished with toasted sesame and fine scallion curls.

dishes.name: Dahi Ke Kebab
dishes.description: Velvety hung curd patties with a golden crust and aromatic herb filling.
dishes.fullDescription: Pillowy patties of hand-hung creamy yogurt, delicately spiked with chopped mint, green chilies, roasted cashew nuts, and roasted cumin seeds, shallow pan-seared in desi ghee.
dishes.chefNote: Crisp on the outside, melts like velvet on the tongue.

dishes.name: Haryali Paneer Tikka
dishes.description: Tandoori cottage cheese cubes marinated in mint, coriander and spices.
dishes.fullDescription: Thick slabs of fresh malai paneer steeped in a rich emerald paste of garden mint, coriander, baby spinach, roasted cumin and rock salt, skewered with bell peppers and roasted in clay oven.
dishes.chefNote: Basted with butter and chaat masala straight from the tandoor.

dishes.name: Hestiia Golden Spring Rolls
dishes.description: Crisp pastry wrappers stuffed with shredded wok vegetables and glass noodles.
dishes.fullDescription: Paper-thin golden pastry rolls packed with julienned cabbage, carrots, bell peppers, bean sprouts and glass noodles, served with sweet chili dip and hot garlic sauce.
dishes.chefNote: Fried to a golden shatteringly crisp perfection.

dishes.name: Wok Paneer Manchurian
dishes.description: Crispy cottage cheese tossed in a savory ginger, garlic, and scallion sauce.
dishes.fullDescription: Fried golden cottage cheese cubes tossed in an aromatic dark savory glaze made with braised ginger, garlic, chopped coriander roots, green chilies, and light soy sauce.
dishes.chefNote: Can be ordered dry as a starter or semi-gravy for pairing with rice.

dishes.name: Burnt Garlic Fried Rice
dishes.description: Fragrant jasmine rice wok-tossed with aromatic golden burnt garlic and scallions.
dishes.fullDescription: Fluffy steamed rice wok-seared over high flame with crunchy golden burnt garlic flakes, finely diced spring vegetables, white pepper and toasted sesame oil.
dishes.chefNote: Smoky wok aroma (wok hei) in every spoonful.

dishes.name: Hestiia Paneer Fried Rice
dishes.description: Wok-tossed rice loaded with seasoned paneer cubes and crunchy vegetables.
dishes.fullDescription: Savory stir-fried rice loaded with lightly charred paneer cubes, sweet corn, carrots, French beans, and scallions in a light soy seasoning.
dishes.chefNote: A wholesome meal enjoyed across all age groups.

dishes.name: Chilli Garlic Hakka Noodles
dishes.description: Tossed noodles with a robust red chilli and roasted garlic punch.
dishes.fullDescription: Classic wheat noodles wok-tossed with julienne cabbage, bell peppers, scallions, fiery chili oil, and generous heaps of crushed roasted garlic.

dishes.name: Hestiia Chef Special Noodles
dishes.description: Signature wok-tossed noodles with paneer, exotic veggies and secret spice sauce.
dishes.fullDescription: Chef signature noodle preparation featuring yellow zucchini, baby corn, broccoli, shredded paneer and wok-smoked scallions in an exclusive five-spice sauce.
dishes.chefNote: Crafted exclusively by our executive chef for Hestiia guests.

dishes.name: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
dishes.description: Baby potatoes simmered in a velvety Kashmiri chilli and fennel yogurt gravy.
dishes.fullDescription: Pricked baby potatoes deep-fried till golden, then slow-cooked under dough seal (dum) in an aromatic yogurt-based gravy flavored with Kashmiri deggi mirch, saunf (fennel) and dry ginger (sonth).
dishes.chefNote: Authentic recipe free of onion and garlic, bursting with rich warm spices.

dishes.name: Awadhi Korma Platter
dishes.description: Tender simmered Awadhi gravy with saffron essence
dishes.fullDescription: Tender simmered Awadhi gravy with saffron essence

reviews.comment: Very authentic dum aroma and authentic long-grain basmati rice. Slight delay on weekend peak hours, but food quality is unmatched.
